description: Work inbox of a mid-level engineering manager at a B2B SaaS company. Receives a steady mix of internal team coordination, vendor and partner correspondence, customer escalations forwarded from support, recruiting pipeline updates, and routine operational noise like CI/CD alerts, billing notifications, and newsletter digests. Urgency spikes around sprint boundaries and quarterly planning cycles. Tone is mostly professional-casual. A meaningful fraction of mail requires a real decision or reply; the rest is FYI or can be ignored.
